item.title: Serving Krishna by Serving Tulasi
item.description: By Vishakha Devi Dasi Srila Jiva Gosvami, arguably one of the greatest spiritual scholars in the history of religion, said that one does not really accept God unless one accepts his inconceivable nature. item.title: Role Of Guest Reception Service
item.description: By Sri Sri Radha Gopinath Mandir 1) Who is a guest? The Sanskrit word atithi means ‘not scheduled’.
